name: realistic-fusion-refreshed
title: Realistic Fusion Refreshed
author: Truls Johnsen
description:
Fusion power modelled on real physics. Reactors run a real-time simulation, computing reaction rate from tabulated cross-section data rather than implying it through recipe ratios. Requires Realistic Fusion Refreshed Core.

Before you install, two things this mod will not do. Saves from Realistic Fusion Power or Durikkan's 2.0 port are NOT supported: this mod shares no prototype names with either, so nothing carries over and no migration is provided. Durikkan's port can stay installed beside this one if you want to compare them, which is what the distinct prefix buys; the 1.1 original cannot, because it declares Factorio 1.1 and will not load under 2.0 at all. And the buildings here are NOT balanced for quality. The mod loads and runs under Space Age with quality enabled, verified against Factorio 2.0.77, and that is the whole of the claim: nothing in it is tuned against quality, or against the vanilla fusion reactor.

Credit for the original design goes to Romner_set, for the 2.0 port to Durikkan, and for graphics work to PreLeyZero; none of their licences asks for it. The graphics shipped here are Krastorio 2's, under LGPLv3 -- see legal-note.txt beside this file.
